{{Quote|Whatever happened to P'loh?"<br />"She was assigned to Belkadan, and died there.|Tahiri Veila and Nen Yim discuss P'loh|<ref name="TFP" />}}
'''P'loh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and one of future [[Shaper caste|shaper]] [[Nen Yim]]'s crèche-mates. At one point P'loh, Yim and another of her crèche-mates, [[Zhul]], stole a [[korsk]]. This [[Sentience/Legends|creature]], used by the Yuuzhan Vong for cleaning, was released by P'loh and Zhul into a communal [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] area whereupon it consumed all of the [[i'fii]] there. Later, during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], P'loh was assigned to the<ref name="TFP" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]], where she [[Death/Legends|died]].<ref name="TFP" />

Yim's memories of P'loh were transferred to captured [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tahiri Veila]]<ref name="TFP" /> when she was experimented upon by the renegade shaper [[Mezhan Kwaad]] and implanted with a Yuuzhan Vong persona known as Riina.<ref name="EoV1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref> Veila discussed her implanted memories with Yim, who divulged that the memories of P'loh were her own.<ref name="TFP" />

==Behind the scenes==
P'loh was first mentioned in [[Greg Keyes]]' [[2003]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''.<ref name="TFP" />
